name: crystal_lesson
description: Record, resolve, or list lessons learned across crystals to prevent cognitive regression, repeated friction, and agent amnesia.

action.description: Action: record (capture lesson), resolve (mark resolved/actioned), dismiss, or list

crystal_id.description: Target crystal ID (required for record and resolve; optional for list)

id.description: Lesson identifier (e.g. lesson-1; required for resolve/dismiss; optional for record)

observed_friction.description: Description of the observed friction or failure pattern (required for record)

root_cause.description: Root cause analysis of the friction (optional)

recommended_action.description: Actionable pattern, rule, or remediation to prevent recurrence (optional for record)

action_summary.description: Summary of resolution action taken (optional for resolve)

actor_id.description: Entity ID performing the action (optional, defaults to agt_mcp)

status.description: Filter status for list action (optional: open, actioned, dismissed)
